in_sanskrit.name: प्राग्यान्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: प्राग् (praag) - before, earlier यान् (yyan) - vehicle, carrier Therefore, Pragyan means 'vehicle of intelligence' or 'carrier of wisdom'

in_hindi.name: प्राग्यान
in_hindi.meaning: प्राग् (prag) - before, earlier यान (yyan) - vehicle, carrier Therefore, Pragyan means 'vehicle of intelligence' or 'carrier of wisdom'

in_tamil.name: பிரக்யன்
in_tamil.meaning: பிர (pir) - before, earlier க்யான் (gyan) - knowledge, wisdom Therefore, Pragyan means 'before the knowledge' or 'prior wisdom'

in_telugu.name: ప్రాజ్యన్
in_telugu.meaning: ప్రా (praa) - before, earlier జ్యాన్ (jyan) - knowledge, wisdom Therefore, Pragyan means 'before the knowledge' or 'prior wisdom'

in_marathi.name: Pragyan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pragyan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has acquired knowledge and wisdom through deep understanding and experience.

in_bengali.name: Pragyan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Wisdom, Knowledge
in_bengali.long_meaning: Pragyan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has acquired knowledge and wisdom through deep understanding and experience.
